current_execution.explanation: R31 source recovery reached an already-latched I/O admission deferral while reading saved response evidence. The original serialization wait recorded IO_MEMORY_POOL_LANES_BUSY after 16.43 seconds against a 15-second unscoped wait. It had no resource error or external pressure reason. Exact old-code replay reproduced the failure chain: a pending reservation owned by this pool could be treated as foreign resource pressure, then poison later requests through a global latch. The original log did not identify the token holder; that precise interleaving is reproduced engineering evidence, not a recorded historical thread identity. The caller escalated the latch into a durable source-evidence stop. This differs from R30’s original-clock failure. A failed conditional-write counter alone does not establish a storage conflict as the cause.
current_execution.next_work: R32 prepares stage receipts, request and partition recovery, cached verification, concurrent preparation and a replenished scientific process pool. The separately measured 36-task fitting catalog is durable new work; do not refit its matching components. The exact R32 canonical gate and installation are verified; the full owner campaign remains for user launch.

steps: Resolve the latest verified return and newer durable owner journals again at launch; preserve the distinction between an archive and an unpublished checkpoint.

Verify each stage against stable task identities, relevant code and input fingerprints, dependency hashes and durable output digests. Mark unchanged completed stages SKIPPED_VERIFIED, resume unfinished tasks and invalidate only genuinely affected dependencies.
Authenticate saved fit and prediction receipts against the same inputs, recipe, temporal split and population. Reuse completed scientific work; changed reporting weights alone must not refit it.
Recover completed worker outputs whose parent publication failed. A wrapper or reporting failure must not discard an already completed estimator.
Keep paid source captures and normalized partitions keyed by their real request and content identities. Fetch actual gaps, not the entire history again.
Checkpoint after bounded tasks, stop new admission when interrupted, drain admitted work safely, and publish a verified partial return only after integrity checks.
